test_ExtentTransform: test the ExtentTransform class to crop a segmentation mask from a source rectangle to a specified output size
test_RandomCropFixedAspectRatio: test the RandomCropFixedAspectRatio augmentation to randomly crop an image and mask while maintaining a fixed aspect ratio
test_PadTransform: test the PadTransform class to pad a cropped image region back into its original full-size canvas
test_InvertibleCropTransform: test the InvertibleCropTransform class to crop an image and then invert the transform to restore the original image
test_PadBorderDivisible: test the PadBorderDivisible augmentation to pad an image so its height and width are divisible by a given number
